title: PressGo Freeform Blocks Schema (Pro mode beta — SPIKE)
description: A recursive block tree describing ONE landing-page section as a native Elementor flexbox-container layout. The freeform renderer (class-pressgo-freeform-renderer.php) turns this into native, editable Elementor widget JSON. This is the 'build anything' layer: instead of filling a fixed recipe, the AI composes an arbitrary widget tree. Every block is either a CONTAINER (layout) or a WIDGET (leaf content). The root MUST be a container of type 'section'.

spacing.description: Either a single number (all sides, px) or {top,right,bottom,left} in px.

type.description: section = top-level container (one per tree, full-width band, holds a boxed content area). row = horizontal flex container (its children become equal/explicit-width columns, stacks on mobile). col = vertical flex container (stacks its children). heading/text/button/image/spacer/icon/divider = leaf widgets.

settings.description: Layout + style controls. Only the keys relevant to the block type are read; the rest are ignored.

background.description: CONTAINERS only. A hex color (#181a1c), 'transparent', or a CSS-ish gradient spec 'gradient:#hexA,#hexB,135' (colorA, colorB, angle-deg). Sets the band/column background.

background_image.description: CONTAINERS only. Image URL for a background image (cover). Pair with overlay for legible text.

overlay.description: CONTAINERS only. An rgba()/hex overlay drawn over background_image for contrast, e.g. 'rgba(0,0,0,0.55)'.

padding.description: CONTAINERS. Inner padding (px). Section bands typically want generous vertical padding (80-160).

max_width.description: SECTION only. Max width of the boxed content area in px (e.g. 1200, 800 for a narrow column). Default 1200.

content_align.description: CONTAINERS. Horizontal alignment of children within the container (maps to flex align-items on a column container). 'left' = flex-start.

vertical_align.description: ROW/COL. Vertical alignment of children (flex justify/align).

gap.description: ROW/COL. Flex gap between children in px.

width.description: COL inside a ROW. Explicit column width as a PERCENT (e.g. 60 for a 60/40 split). Omit for equal columns.

radius.description: CONTAINERS/image. Border radius in px (rounded cards, rounded images).

margin.description: CONTAINERS. Outer margin (px). Negative top margin can overlap a card onto the band above.

text.description: heading/button. The visible text (headings: plain text; buttons: label).

html.description: text widget. Inline HTML body (<strong>, <em>, <a> allowed).

tag.description: heading. Semantic level. Hero headline = h1.

color.description: heading/text/icon. Text/glyph color (hex or rgba). On dark backgrounds use light colors.

size.description: heading/text/icon. Font size (heading/text) or icon size in px.

size_mobile.description: heading/text. Mobile font-size override (always set for sizes >= 28).

letter_spacing.description: heading. Letter spacing in px (negative tightens big display type, e.g. -1.5).

line_height.description: heading/text. Line height (em, e.g. 1.1 for display, 1.7 for body).

transform.description: heading. Text transform (eyebrows are often uppercase).

max_text_width.description: text/heading. Cap the measure (readable line length) in px, e.g. 520. The renderer centers it if the block is centered.

bg.description: button. Button background color (the accent). 'transparent' for outline/ghost buttons.

src.description: image. Image URL (only a real, given URL — never invent one).

children.description: CONTAINERS only (section/row/col). Nested blocks. Widgets have no children.

allOf.description: The root block MUST be type 'section'.
